title: loadsheet Scan

tool.description: The tool and version that wrote it, such as loadsheet@0.0.1.

scannedAt.description: When it was scanned, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

items.description: A UTC calendar day, written YYYY-MM-DD.
A UTC calendar day, written YYYY-MM-DD.

window.description: The first and last day it covers, inclusive.

installed.description: Whether the harness's home exists on that machine.

versions.description: Harness versions seen in those sessions.

firstDay.description: The first day with a session.

lastDay.description: The last day with a session.

listing.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

modelUse.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

userUse.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

instructions.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

mcp.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

tokens.description: How well a harness provides a signal: read directly, inferred from indirect evidence, or not at all.

signals.description: How well each signal is provided.

items.description: What one harness on one machine could tell.

coverage.description: What each harness on this machine could tell.

kind.description: What the piece of context is.

name.description: Its name, unique within its kind.

harnesses.description: Ids of the harnesses that load it from this path.

pack.description: Where it came from: a plugin name, `owner/repo`, or a fleetrc source.

path.description: Its file or folder, relative to the home directory (`~/...`) or to the project.

items.description: Its file or folder, relative to the home directory (`~/...`) or to the project.

reaches.description: The paths of the other Items of this machine that removing this one would take or break, worked out on the machine's disk; absent when that is not known.

digest.description: The sha256 of its file content, as lowercase hex.

listed.description: Characters it puts in the context of every session that lists or loads it: a skill's or subagent's name and description, an instruction file's whole text, an MCP server's instructions.

body.description: Characters loaded only when it is invoked: the rest of a skill's or subagent's file; 0 for instruction files and MCP servers.

chars.description: Its size in characters: listed is paid by every session that lists or loads it, body only by a session that invokes it.

modelInvocable.description: Whether the model may invoke it on its own.

items.description: One installed piece of context found on disk (or in a pack). The same id at two paths is two Items.

via.description: The entrypoint or originator that started the sessions.

fixedTokens.description: First-request input tokens, summed over the sessions that reported them.

measured.description: Sessions that reported their first-request input tokens.

items.description: Additive session totals for one harness, day and entrypoint: the denominator for every share.

via.description: The entrypoint or originator that started the sessions, such as cli or an app's name.

sessions.description: Sessions that listed it (skill, mcp, subagent) or loaded it (instructions).

bare.description: Of those sessions, how many listed it without its description.

chars.description: Characters it occupied, summed over those sessions.

items.description: Additive usage counters for one item, in one harness, on one day, through one entrypoint.

description: One machine's counters for a window: what is installed and how it was used, with no text. Scans of the same machine merge by summing their counters; Scans of different machines stay separate, and a Report is built from the list.
